{"filename":"models.py","content":"import sqlite3
from flask import g, current_app

def get_db():
    if "db" not in g:
        g.db = sqlite3.connect(current_app.config.get("DATABASE", "tasks.db"))
        g.db.row_factory = sqlite3.Row
    return g.db

def close_db(e=None):
    db = g.pop("db", None)
    if db is not None:
        db.close()

def init_app(app):
    app.teardown_appcontext(close_db)
    app.config.setdefault("DATABASE", "tasks.db")
    with app.app_context():
        db = get_db()
        db.execute(
            """
            CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS task (
                id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
                title TEXT NOT NULL,
                description TEXT NOT NULL,
                due_date TEXT,
                status TEXT NOT NULL
            )
            """
        )
        db.commit()
